# ERP Talent Hub

> ERP Talent Hub is the only recruiting platform built exclusively for ERP professionals and the verified recruiters who hire them. No generalist noise — every profile is an ERP specialist, every recruiter is verified.

## What it is

ERP Talent Hub connects SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor, Sage, Workday, NetSuite and IFS professionals with verified ERP recruiters across Europe and beyond. Candidates create a free profile and get discovered. Recruiters verify their identity and access the talent pool.

## Who it is for

- **ERP professionals** (candidates): SAP, Oracle EBS, Oracle Fusion, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft AX, Infor LN, Infor M3, Sage X3, Workday, NetSuite, IFS consultants, functional analysts, project managers, architects and developers seeking new roles
- **Recruiters**: verified LinkedIn Recruiter licence holders, HR professionals with a business email, and recruiting agencies hiring for ERP roles

## How it works

### For candidates
1. Create a free profile in 5 minutes — add ERP systems, modules, experience, location
2. Get discovered by verified ERP recruiters via targeted filters
3. A recruiter contacts you first via platform chat — your email, phone and LinkedIn stay private until you choose to share them

### For recruiters
1. Verify identity via LinkedIn Recruiter (instant, free) or business email (reviewed within 24h)
2. Search and filter the ERP talent pool by system, module, seniority, country
3. Open conversations, track selection pipeline stage by stage

## Pricing

- **Candidates**: completely free, no premium tier
- **Recruiters — LinkedIn Recruiter path**: free after one-time verification (LinkedIn Recruiter licence required)
- **Recruiters — Pro plan**: €49/month, business email verification, no LinkedIn Recruiter required
- **Recruiters — Agency plan**: €149/month, unlimited recruiters under the same company domain

## Key features

- ERP-only platform — no generalist candidates or recruiters
- Verified recruiter gate — every recruiter passes identity verification before accessing profiles
- Privacy-first — candidate contact details (email, phone, LinkedIn) are hidden by default
- Live talent counter — real-time count of ERP professionals on the platform
- Mia AI assistant — helps candidates and recruiters navigate the platform; Pro recruiter feature: AI candidate match (describe ideal candidate, Mia scans the pool and returns top matches)
- Multilingual — English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese
- Pipeline tracking — recruiters track each candidate through: Contacted → Screening → Interviews → Assessment → Offer → Hired
- Selection pipeline visible to both sides
- Referral system — candidates can invite colleagues for a visibility boost

## ERP systems covered

SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, Oracle EBS, Oracle Fusion, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft AX, Infor LN, Infor M3, Sage X3, Workday, NetSuite, IFS

## Privacy and security

- Candidate contact details never shown to recruiters without explicit consent
- All data stored in the EU (West EU — Ireland) via Supabase
- Row Level Security enforced at database level
- Recruiter verification required before any profile access

## Geography

Global platform. Particularly active in Europe — Italy, Germany, France, Spain, UK, Netherlands, Belgium. Available in 6 languages.
